name: Fellers Food Service Equipment & Design
old_description: Bringing Foodservice Equipment and Design Together Since 1945
about:
Fellers Food Service Equipment & Design has operated from Springfield, Missouri since 1945. The company began as a supplier of foodservice equipment and has evolved to offer design services alongside a broad product catalog. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The firm provides foodservice kitchen design, equipment specification, and procurement through a physical showroom and catalog. A dedicated design team works with clients to plan efficient kitchen layouts, while the showroom allows hands-on evaluation of equipment. The company emphasizes post-sale service and support. Specific facility size, headcount, and annual volume are not disclosed.

Fellers serves the foodservice and restaurant industries, including independent operators, chains, and institutional kitchens. The company notes it has specialists across all aspects of foodservice operations, though no specific customer names are provided.

The company states its differentiation lies in a continuing mission to learn and create better ways for customers to do business, focusing on customer success rather than simply selling equipment. It highlights "service after the sale" and a design-led approach as core to its value proposition.
